items.t: Plastic intake manifold cracks and dumps coolant
items.job: Replace intake manifold with revised design and gaskets
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $1,700; TrueDelta owners report $1,275 to $1,500.

items.t: Coolant seeping at the front of the intake manifold
Automatic transmission slips, shifts erratically or fails
Misfire from a failed ignition coil
Clicking behind the dash or air stuck on hot or cold
items.job: Replace blend door actuator (or blend door)
items.note: If the dash must come out to reach the door, cost can top $1,200 as one owner reports.

items.t: Worn ball joints and loose front end
Loose steering from worn tie rods or steering linkage
items.job: Replace tie rod ends or idler/Pitman arm and align

items.t: Fuel pump failure causes stalling or no start
items.note: One owner reports $300 for the part and $225 labor.

items.t: Gas pump keeps shutting off when refueling
items.job: Replace evaporative emissions vent valve or canister

items.t: Power window stops working from a broken regulator
A/C stops blowing cold
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, accumulator and orifice tube, then recharge

items.t: Rear air suspension sags
items.job: Replace rear air springs or install coil spring conversion
items.note: One owner reports $330 for a coil conversion.

items.t: Squealing or chirping from the belt idler or tensioner
items.job: Replace idler pulley or belt tensioner and belt

items.t: Alternator failure
Headlights suddenly go out (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford or Lincoln dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Rusted steering shaft can cause loss of steering (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford or Lincoln dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Cruise control switch can start an underhood fire (recall)
items.job: Disconnect or replace switch and add fused jumper (recalls 07V-336, 08V-051)
items.note: Free at a Ford or Lincoln dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Battery cable can overheat and cause a fire (recall)
items.job: Inspect or replace positive battery cable (recall 05V-518)
items.note: Free at a Ford or Lincoln dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Front wheel hub can fracture (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford or Lincoln dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford or Lincoln dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.

items.note: Free at a Ford or Lincoln dealer if the recall has not been done. Check your VIN on NHTSA.gov.
